copy.tagline: 优化多云成本，利用预留实例和竞价定价
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责云成本控制，需要降低AWS/Azure/GCP支出
copy.tagline_en: Optimize multi-cloud costs with reserved instances and spot pricing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cloud costs and need to reduce AWS/Azure/GCP spending

howto.what: 帮助用户监控、分析和优化云成本，提供预留实例、Spot实例、合理调整大小等策略，并给出具体命令和步骤。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何减少云开销、优化资源配置或分析成本时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下AWS上这个月的成本使用情况。
找出所有未使用的EBS卷和弹性IP。
say.note: Claude会列出闲置资源并建议删除。

say.text: 针对稳定的工作负载推荐使用预留实例。
say.note: Claude会解释预留实例的优势并给出购买建议。

howto.what_en: Helps monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, and GCP, providing strategies like reserved instances, spot pricing, and right-sizing, with concrete commands and steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about reducing cloud spending, optimizing resource allocation, or analyzing costs.

say_en.text: Analyze my AWS cost usage for this month.
say_en.note: Claude queries Cost Explorer and presents cost breakdown.

say_en.text: Find all unused EBS volumes and Elastic IPs.
say_en.note: Claude lists idle resources and suggests deletion.

say_en.text: Recommend reserved instances for stable workloads.
say_en.note: Claude explains benefits and provides purchasing advice.
